summary: A broad technology-led selloff hit US markets on 5 November: the Nasdaq Composite fell 5.5%, the S&P 500 4.4% and the Dow 3.4%, and the VIX jumped 70% to 28.2, with chip stocks down 9% to 17% (AMD, Micron and Lam Research the weakest) after weak Qualcomm, Arm and GlobalFoundries outlooks and worries about data-centre build-out. Country funds for South Korea (EWY, down 13%) and Taiwan (EWT, down 12%) fell hardest, and Asian chip names such as SK Hynix and Tokyo Electron fell 9% in the 5 November session. Brent recovered about 4% after Wednesday's 9% drop, while gold edged up and the 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.84%. In rates, Banxico cut 25 basis points to 6.25% on 5 November and the RBA hiked to 4.85% on 3 November; the Bank of England was reported to have raised Bank Rate on 5 November, though that rests on one secondary recap. Mosaic and Maersk were among large single-stock movers whose catalysts were not confirmed in this run.

reading.title: UK Launches Energy Independence Bill
reading.summary: The UK government's Energy Independence Bill passed its first reading in the House of Commons on November 4.

reading.title: A cybersecurity checklist for the animal protein industry
reading.summary: Questions producers can ask agtech vendors about data handling, network security, patching and remote access to protect livestock and processing operations.

reading.title: Better Meat Co targets large-scale production in India in Q2, 2027 amid brutal mycoprotein shakeout
reading.summary: Now BMC Ingredients, the company plans commercial mycelium production with an Indian partner after large fermentation runs and its first seven-figure supply contract.

reading.title: Panamint Capital closes $1.8bn loan for Big Rooter Power
reading.summary: Panamint Capital has finalized the first stage of a $1.8bn green loan to build Big Rooter Power.

reading.title: NHPC and Essar announce $475m renewable project in Andhra Pradesh, India
reading.summary: Essar Renewables has signed a power purchase agreement with NHPC for a 300MW renewable project in Andhra Pradesh.

reading.title: The wins and weak spots in America's solar supply chain
reading.summary: Clean Investment Monitor data indicate onshoring of the US solar supply chain is progressing, with gains in some segments and weak spots in others.

overlap.reason: US solar manufacturing read-through for a domestic panel maker.

reading.title: Democrats' state wins open the door for major clean energy progress
reading.summary: Democratic midterm gains give the party congressional control, though presidential vetoes limit federal options, while state-level wins create nearer-term openings for clean energy policy.

overlap.reason: Clean energy policy outlook bears on clean energy equities.

reading.title: Will PG&E's $2B grid cutbacks derail California's clean energy buildout?
reading.summary: California Wire newsletter on PG&E trimming about $2 billion in grid investments and what that could mean for the state's clean energy buildout.

reading.title: World embraces gold while US resists shift, advisor says
reading.summary: Governments outside the G7 are increasingly buying gold as a hedge against future financial crises, according to an adviser, while the US resists the shift.

overlap.reason: Piece is about official-sector gold demand.

reading.title: Paraguay crisis threatens emerging uranium ambitions
reading.summary: Political upheaval in Paraguay clouds prospects for foreign exploration investment as the country courts US capital for its emerging uranium sector.

overlap.reason: Uranium exploration prospects in a new jurisdiction.

reading.title: New gold discovery boosts Perpetua's Stibnite project
reading.summary: Perpetua reports a new gold discovery at Fiddle, with a drill hole returning high-grade gold and antimony near the Stibnite project.

overlap.reason: Gold discovery; company is a gold and antimony developer.

reading.title: Ammonia-Powered Bulk Carrier Takes on Green Fuel in Australian First
reading.summary: Australia completed its first green ammonia bunkering for an ammonia-powered bulk carrier, a step toward alternative fuels in commercial shipping.

reading.title: Finnish Court Jails Cargo Ship Captain, Crew Member for Baltic Sea Cable Sabotage
reading.summary: A Finnish court convicted the Russian captain and an Azerbaijani crew member of the Fitburg of aggravated sabotage over damage to two subsea telecom cables in the Gulf of Finland.

reading.title: MARAD Approves $1 Billion Offshore Crude Oil Export Port Off Louisiana
reading.summary: The US administration approved a $1 billion offshore crude export project off Louisiana, clearing a major regulatory hurdle.

overlap.reason: US crude export capacity read-through.

reading.title: Seven Shadow Fleet Tankers Spoof AIS to Hide Novorossiysk Voyages
reading.summary: Windward reports seven sanctioned Russian tankers faked AIS positions for 90 days to appear to drift near the Bosphorus while actually sailing covertly.

overlap.reason: Sanctioned tanker activity bears on tanker market.

reading.title: Newbuilding Orders Piling Up
reading.summary: Banchero Costa says newbuilding activity stayed elevated, with 51 vessels ordered in a week across bulk, container, tanker and car carrier segments.

reading.title: Inmarsat Maritime Safety Data Hub to help shipping weather the storm
reading.summary: Argues that better data can reduce the frequency and severity of deep-sea shipping incidents as maritime threats evolve.

reading.title: IETA, PDF, And WCS Call On COP31 Delegates To Address Article 6.4 Bottlenecks
reading.summary: IETA, the Project Developer Forum and WCS urge COP31 negotiators to resolve obstacles in the Article 6.4 carbon crediting mechanism.

overlap.reason: Carbon market rules affect carbon credit pricing.

reading.title: New Isometric Service Helps Exporters Prepare For EU Carbon Border Checks
reading.summary: Isometric has launched a service that helps firms selling into the EU organize their emissions data for border carbon review.

overlap.reason: EU carbon border mechanism links to EU carbon pricing.

reading.title: Robinson Carbon To Build New $16.3M Biochar Facility In Louisiana
reading.summary: Robinson Carbon, the carbon products arm of Robinson Lumber Company, is putting $16.3 million into a new biochar plant in Louisiana.

reading.title: RadianX promises solar-powered devices that never need charging
reading.summary: RadianX says its perovskite solar cells could make charging unnecessary for some portable devices that draw too much power for conventional panels.

climate.headline: JMA: El Nino at record intensity, certain to last through winter
climate.detail: Tokyo Climate Center says El Nino has been the strongest on record since September and is virtually certain to continue to boreal winter; DJF guidance shows high odds of above-normal temperature and rainfall over parts of East Asia.
climate.source: Japan Meteorological Agency, Tokyo Climate Center, 22 Oct 2026

climate.headline: COP31 opens in Antalya 9 Nov; Article 6 talks focus on putting rules into practice
climate.detail: Talks run 9-20 Nov with a leaders' summit 11-12 Nov; Article 6.2 reporting and registries and Article 6.4 (PACM) methodology and CDM transition are on the agenda, with no rulebook rewrite expected.
climate.source: CarbonCredits.com preview of UNFCCC COP31 agenda, accessed 6 Nov 2026

climate.headline: Pakistan rains well below average; USDA sees first Indian rice output fall in 10 years
climate.detail: Jun-Sep rainfall was well below average in Sindh, Balochistan and southern Punjab, cutting kharif output; India's 2026/27 rice crop is projected down 4.6% (USDA figures), with stocks about three times the buffer norm.

climate.headline: El Nino puts palm oil and Thai rice supply at risk
climate.detail: Indonesia and Malaysia supply 87% of palm oil exports, with output averaging 4% below normal in strong El Nino years; Thailand's 2026/27 rice crop is projected 2% smaller.
